verses.1: Hear what the LORD has said to you, as it is written in the Book of Israel.
verses.2: So said Jehovah: “Let the nations learn from this. Do not let them fall from heaven, for they will surely fall from where they came.”
verses.3: For the laws of the nations are like trees that have been cut down by the hands of those who want to destroy them.
verses.4: In gold and silver, let them be adorned in decorations and ornaments. Let them be strengthened through these things; otherwise, they will not be beautiful.
verses.5: They are like heavy chains that cannot be broken. They will not speak or act in any way, because they cannot walk. Do not fear them, for they do not harm anyone. And they also do no good at all.
verses.6: Where else is there a God like You, O Great One? Your name is great in glory.
verses.7: Who doesn’t see that you are the king of nations? For in all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like you.
verses.8: And in one moment, they will be destroyed and covered with the ruin of their own actions. The tree of life will also be destroyed.
verses.9: Silver from mines is mined, and gold comes from underground deposits. These are products of skilled labor; they’re made by craftsmen who use tools and machinery. All of these are products of wisdom.
verses.10: And Jehovah God is true. He is the living God and the King of eternity. No nations will be able to destroy Him in His wrath.
verses.11: May they be said to be under the command of the Lord, who is called “Yahweh”. They shall not serve other gods, nor will they perish from the world. And from the throne of Yahweh, these are those who belong to Him.
verses.12: He creates the earth with his power; he prepares the sea with his wisdom and planning. He turns the heavens toward him.
verses.13: To the sound of its cry, the waters rose from the heavens. They were carried up from the edges of the earth in showers. And from its treasures, wind was released.
verses.14: Every man is ashamed of the knowledge of pride. Every person is disgusted by falsehoods, for they are full of lies and no spirit in them at all.
verses.15: The wicked will be destroyed when they are punished. They will be destroyed completely.
verses.16: These are not Jacob’s share at all. After all, he is the one who created everything. Israel is his descendant. It belongs to Jehovah, the God of hosts.
verses.17: I will gather those from your land, who sit in captivity.
verses.18: For thus said Jehovah: “I will take away the inhabitants of the earth at this time, and I will make them suffer so that they may be redeemed.”
verses.19: Oh, what a pity that my inheritance has been taken away from me! I said, “But this is what happens when one is sick.”
verses.20: My tent and all my possessions have been destroyed. My children have left me, and they never return. My tent is no longer standing, and my structures have collapsed.
verses.21: For the wicked were afraid, and they did not seek after Jehovah. Therefore, they did not understand, and all their evil deeds were destroyed.
verses.22: The sound of destruction has arrived. A great noise comes from the land of Tzafen, to destroy the cities of Judah, which are now in ruins.
verses.23: I knew that Jehovah said that no man’s path is without someone who prepares for his journey.
verses.24: May the LORD remove me, but only in accordance with justice and fairness, so that I may not be harmed.
verses.25: Spread your heat upon those nations who do not know you. And upon their families, whom your name does not bring them to remember as having eaten of Jacob’s flesh. They ate him and devoured him, and they buried his body.
